scope: Myhra rebuilt shot and manual real-round replay preview

generated.work: Generated project-owner golfer and humanoid rig. Anatomical grip/finger/thumb corrections and four baked driver/iron/chip/putt actions authored in Blender; no downloaded motion-capture animations. Desktop and mobile texture derivatives.
Generated and retopologized golf cart; windshield separated from opaque body and given a clear material.

credit_ledger.note: Original-pass costs retained. The current account balance includes activity outside this rebuild; do not attribute the difference to this pass.

cc0.work: Four-view atlas baked from original full-detail tree, retaining twig alpha. Near-tree mesh LOD and mobile texture derivative from the same original CC0 tree.
Original HDR downsampled to 1024x512 for the mobile tier.

course_references.usage: Reviewed official hole-one diagram, strategic description and linked drone film. Images and videos are references only; they are not bundled in this game.
Inspected tee at 9 seconds: open descending corridor, woods on right. Film date not established.
Reviewed club course photograph, water and surrounding maintained grounds.

Pages 2 and 15 document work around Hole 1 green/foregreen and the creation of a pond in 2024. This postdates the terrain source. The report establishes that these changes occurred, but supplies no surveyed contours or coordinates.

terrain: Kartverket-derived source grid, plus separately authored bunker basin/lip height derivatives. Render, collision, grid and physics share those derivatives. Added density is not a green survey. See hole.json surfaceAuthorship and tools/author-bunker-basins.mjs.
limitations: Pond shape and path are approximations informed by references, not a measured reconstruction.
Only Myhra receives this visual treatment. Other holes retain the earlier community course preview.
Physical iPhone and PS5 hardware still require hands-on testing; browser verification uses Chrome, WebKit and a simulated standard gamepad.
Mobile texture residency is a budget estimate, not a physical GPU measurement.
Visual course acceptance and professional swing approval have not been certified.
